name: Tailscale
description: Share Ledger on your tailnet via Tailscale Serve; tailnet devices and alerts on the dashboard; Tailscale subscription bookkeeping.

fields.label: Tailscale API login
fields.help: Read-only access is enough: scopes devices:core:read and users:read. Only needed for the Devices, Users and Billing tabs.

fields.label: OAuth client ID
fields.help: Tailscale admin console → Settings → OAuth clients.

fields.label: API access token
fields.help: Starts with tskey-api-. Tailscale admin console → Settings → Keys. Expires after at most 90 days.

fields.label: Tailnet
fields.help: "-" means the tailnet the credentials belong to.

fields.label: Warn when a device is offline (days)
Record the subscription in the ledger
fields.help: Monthly charge = active users × price per user + flat fee, posted from the Billing tab.

fields.label: Price per user / month
fields.help: In the currency below, e.g. 6.00 (Starter) or 18.00 (Premium).

fields.label: Expense account (debit)
fields.help: An active expense account in that currency, e.g. 6400.

fields.label: Paid from (credit)
fields.help: An active asset (bank) or liability (credit card) account in that currency, e.g. 2100.

fields.label: Remind me on day of month
